title: Masoon Export Manifest v1
description: Header on the first line of a masoon.jsonl.v1 export. Validate each subsequent line with the export-record schema.

format.description: Required format discriminator for the streaming export reader.

exported_at.description: Export timestamp supplied by the exporter.

plan_count.description: Number of plan records carried by this file. The plan records define the actual plan boundaries.

Iso8601DateTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with UTC Z or an explicit numeric offset.
